stages.text: A job on the notice board on the Torplatz: graves have been desecrated at the old crypt. 50 silver for dealing with those responsible.
Cultists hide in the old crypt. Find out what they are doing there.
Malrek, a wounded cultist: the priest is further down in the crypt.
Older letters beneath the inscription: "We did not seal away the dead. We sealed away their voices."
The cult is led by Priest Vaelor. He claims the dead will return.
